name: Zerops
line: Deploys apps, static sites and managed databases from Git.

free.text: Lightweight core: 15 build h, 100 GB egress, 5 GB backup; app resources extra

($0.60 core + 4.5 × $0.75 RAM + $0.10 disk) × 730 divided by 720, + $3 for IPv4 = $7.13 before tax. 1.125 GB exceeds 1 GiB; core is shared. 100 GB sent out and 100 build minutes fit the quotas. Throughput untested.
